ui.title: Computer health summary
ui.footer: Checked with Chiron Stick. This is a snapshot of today, not a guarantee: drives and batteries can fail without warning.
overall.green: Good shape: nothing needs attention right now.
overall.yellow: Mostly fine, but some things need attention soon.
overall.red: Problems found: see the red lines below.
battery.unknown: The battery didn't report its health.
battery.green: The battery holds {pct}% of its original charge. No action needed.
battery.green.h: The battery holds {pct}% of its original charge: about {hours} hours away from the charger at the current use. No action needed.
battery.yellow: The battery holds {pct}% of its original charge. It is wearing out: plan to replace it within a year or so.
battery.yellow.h: The battery holds {pct}% of its original charge: about {hours} hours away from the charger at the current use. It is wearing out: plan to replace it within a year or so.
battery.red: The battery holds only {pct}% of its original charge. Replacement recommended.
battery.red.h: The battery holds only {pct}% of its original charge: expect about {hours} hours away from the charger. Replacement recommended.
storage.unknown: The drive {model} ({size}) didn't share its health data.
storage.yellow: The drive {model} ({size}) shows early warning signs. Back up important files and keep an eye on it.
storage.red: The drive {model} ({size}) has serious problems. Back up important files now and replace the drive.
memory.ok: The memory ({gib} GiB) reports no errors.
memory.yellow: The memory corrected some errors by itself. Run a full memory test (MemTest86 on this stick).
memory.red: The memory has errors it couldn't correct. A memory module probably needs replacing.
ram_test.red: The memory test found errors. A memory module probably needs replacing.
cpu_idle.green: The processor stays cool at rest ({temp} °C).
cpu_idle.yellow: The processor is warm even at rest ({temp} °C). Cleaning dust out of the fans and vents may help.
cpu_idle.red: The processor is hot even at rest ({temp} °C). The cooling needs service: clean the fans and replace the thermal paste.
cpu_load.green: Under full load the processor stayed cool enough and kept its speed (max {max} °C).
cpu_load.yellow: Under full load the processor reached its temperature limit and slowed down a little (max {max} °C, {drop}% slower). Cleaning the cooling system is recommended.
cpu_load.red: Under full load the processor overheated or slowed down a lot (max {max} °C, {drop}% slower). The cooling needs service: clean the fans and replace the thermal paste.
fans.red: A fan didn't spin under load. Check or replace it.
gpu.yellow: Graphics ran without hardware acceleration on this stick (a driver matter), so the test says little.
gpu.red: The graphics test crashed or froze. Possible graphics fault.
kernel_log.yellow: Some hardware warnings were logged ({what}). Usually harmless, but worth watching.
kernel_log.red: Hardware errors were logged ({what}). See the technical report.
devices.green: All built-in devices work with this stick.
devices.yellow: {n} device(s) have no driver on this stick. That is not a hardware fault.
devices.red: Some devices report errors ({what}). Possible hardware fault.
diskspace.none: No Windows or Linux installation was found.
diskspace.encrypted: The drive is encrypted ({kind}), so free space wasn't checked.
diskspace.yellow: {os} is getting full ({free} free, {pct}%). Delete files you don't need.
diskspace.red: {os} is almost full ({free} free, {pct}%). This slows the computer down and blocks updates: free up space.
win11.yellow: Windows 11 readiness couldn't be fully checked: {why}.
sbcerts.green: Secure Boot certificates are up to date.
sbcerts.yellow: Secure Boot certificates are out of date (2011 versions). Install Windows updates or a firmware update.
sbcerts.info: Secure Boot certificates couldn't be checked.
firmware.update: A firmware (BIOS) update is available from the maker. It was not installed.
